name: Ao, the Dawn Sky
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance
When Ao dies, choose one —
• Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put any number of nonland permanent cards with total mana value 4 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
• Put two +1/+1 counters on each permanent you control that's a creature or Vehicle.
blocked_sentences: • Look at the top seven cards of your library. Put any number of nonland permanent cards with total mana value 4 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

needs.what: a `total_mana_value` cap on look_at_top's pick (and search_library/reveal_until): choose any number of cards from the looked-at window whose combined mana value is at most N, e.g. look_at_top amount 7, selector nonland permanent, destination battlefield, up to any number, total_mana_value 4, rest_to_bottom
needs.why_existing_wont_do: total_mana_value exists only as a target_keys entry (targeting.py _within_total) and in cost_reduction; library cards in a look_at_top window are not targets, and look_at_top's pick_from_pool takes a fixed count from the selector with no running budget. choose_mode's `budget` prices modes, not cards. A per-card mana_value <= 4 selector is a strictly better card (could put several 4-drops).
